answers.question: Predict the share of claims each version will get right (its verdict matches the dataset's label), as a percentage. A guess is fine; the reasons are what I grade.
answers.answer:
No tools | 10% | 40% | 50% | Without any tools, it will likely need more lookups
One search | 20% | 35% | 45% | With one search, it might get to the right answer faster but not quite
Agent | 30% | 45% | 25% | An agent will be faster and more efficient

answers.question: How many lookups will the agent make per claim, on average? Why?
answers.answer: On average, it will make around 3-4. This is because it often needs more than two, but very rarely needs more than 5, so an inbetween those two seems a good standard.
